title: Der Hauswart
desc: Ruedi Zemp looks at your bicycle for a long moment and says nothing

sn.s: Im Bad geht das Licht nicht.
sn.e: The light in the bathroom does not work.
On Monday it still works.
On Tuesday it is broken.
Broken is broken.

sn.s: Etwas ist immer kaputt in einer alten Wohnung.
sn.e: Something is always broken in an old flat.

sn.s: Kaputt heisst: es funktioniert nicht mehr.
sn.e: Broken means: it does not work any more.
I press the switch ten times.
The light still does not work.
Nothing works without electricity.
Now everything works again.
I want to repair it myself.
But I have no tools.
I have nothing at all.
I ask Frau Amrein.

sn.s: Sie sagt nur ein Wort: Hauswart.
sn.e: She says only one word: Hauswart.
The caretaker is called Ruedi Zemp.
A caretaker has a lot of buildings.

sn.s: Der Hauswart hat einen Schlüssel für alles.
sn.e: The caretaker has a key for everything.
He lives on the ground floor.

sn.s: An seiner Tür hängt ein Zettel.
sn.e: There is a note on his door.

sn.s: Auf dem Zettel steht eine Zeit.
sn.e: There is a time on the note.

sn.s: Montag bis Freitag, siebzehn bis achtzehn Uhr.
sn.e: Monday to Friday, five to six.
One hour a day.
You have to report a problem.

sn.s: Melden heisst: man sagt es ihm.
sn.e: To report means: you tell him.
You have to report it yourself.
You cannot simply wait.

sn.s: Niemand merkt ein Problem von allein.
sn.e: Nobody notices a problem by themselves.

sn.s: Um siebzehn Uhr klopfe ich an seiner Tür.
sn.e: At five o'clock I knock on his door.
He opens up.

sn.s: Ruedi Zemp ist gross und ruhig.
sn.e: Ruedi Zemp is big and calm.
He is maybe sixty.
He says Grüezi and waits.
He says nothing more.
So I have to talk.

sn.s: Ich sage: Das Licht im Bad ist kaputt.
sn.e: I say: the light in the bathroom is broken.
He says: which flat?
Third floor, I say.
He nods.

sn.s: Er schreibt etwas in ein kleines Buch.
sn.e: He writes something in a small book.

sn.s: Dann sagt er: Morgen um acht.
sn.e: Then he says: tomorrow at eight.
That is all.
The door closes again.

sn.s: Am nächsten Morgen um acht klopft es.
sn.e: The next morning at eight there is a knock.
Eight sharp.

sn.s: Er hat einen Kasten mit Werkzeug dabei.
sn.e: He has a box of tools with him.
He takes his shoes off.

sn.s: Er fragt nicht. Er zieht sie einfach aus.
sn.e: He does not ask. He just takes them off.
Everybody here does that.
He goes into the bathroom.
He looks at the light.
He takes the tools.

sn.s: Nach vier Minuten funktioniert das Licht.
sn.e: After four minutes the light works.
Four minutes.
I say merci vielmal.
He says: no problem.

sn.s: Dann packt er das Werkzeug ein.
sn.e: Then he packs the tools up.
He is about to leave.
Then he sees my bike.

sn.s: Ich kaufe das Velo am Samstag.
sn.e: I buy the bike on Saturday.

sn.s: Es ist eine Occasion und kostet achtzig Franken.
sn.e: It is second-hand and costs eighty francs.

sn.s: Das Velo steht im Gang neben der Tür.
sn.e: The bike is in the hallway next to the door.
Not in the stairwell. In the hallway.

sn.s: In meinem Gang, in meiner Wohnung.
sn.e: In my hallway, in my flat.
He looks at the bike.
He looks at it for a long time.
He says nothing.
He looks at me.

sn.s: Dann schaut er wieder das Velo an.
sn.e: Then he looks at the bike again.
Still nothing.

sn.s: Ich sage: Es steht in der Wohnung.
sn.e: I say: it is in the flat.
He says: yes.

sn.s: Dann sagt er: Der Keller ist grösser.
sn.e: Then he says: the cellar is bigger.
And he goes.

sn.s: Ich stehe im Gang und denke nach.
sn.e: I stand in the hallway and think.
The bike is allowed to be here.

sn.s: Er sagt nicht, es darf nicht.
sn.e: He does not say it is not allowed.

sn.s: Er sagt nur: Der Keller ist grösser.
sn.e: He only says: the cellar is bigger.

sn.s: Am Abend stelle ich das Velo in den Keller.
sn.e: In the evening I put the bike in the cellar.
The caretaker is not a landlord.
He is not a servant either.
He is something in between.

sn.s: Man meldet ihm ein Problem und er repariert es.
sn.e: You report a problem to him and he repairs it.
You do not give him orders.

sn.s: Und man bittet ihn nicht um einen Gefallen.
sn.e: And you do not ask him for a favour.
That is the difference.

sn.s: Frau Amrein erklärt es mir später.
sn.e: Frau Amrein explains it to me later.
She says: Ruedi is good.

sn.s: Aber man muss ihn richtig fragen.
sn.e: But you have to ask him the right way.

sn.s: Sie sagt: Er redet nicht viel.
sn.e: She says: he does not talk much.

sn.s: Sie sagt: Nach zwei Jahren sagt er vielleicht mehr.
sn.e: She says: after two years he might say more.
Two years, I say.
She laughs briefly.

sn.s: Jetzt melde ich jedes Problem sofort.
sn.e: Now I report every problem straight away.

sn.s: Und ich stelle nichts in das Treppenhaus.
sn.e: And I put nothing in the stairwell.

sn.s: Und mein Velo steht im Keller.
sn.e: And my bike is in the cellar.

sn.s: Ruedi Zemp sagt immer noch fast nichts.
sn.e: Ruedi Zemp still says almost nothing.

sn.s: Aber er nickt jetzt im Treppenhaus.
sn.e: But he nods in the stairwell now.
That is a start.
